name: Text Field
description: Text fields let users enter and edit text. They provide a container with labels for user input.

variants.name: Filled
variants.description: Text field with a filled container background

variants.name: Outlined
variants.description: Text field with an outlined border

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style of the text field

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the text field is disabled

props.name: readonly
props.description: Whether the text field is read-only

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the field is required for form submission

props.name: error
props.description: Whether the field is in an error state

props.name: errorText
props.description: Error message to display when in error state

props.name: supportingText
props.description: Helper text displayed below the field

props.name: prefixText
props.description: Text displayed before the input value

props.name: suffixText
props.description: Text displayed after the input value

props.name: rows
props.description: Number of visible rows for textarea type

props.name: name
props.description: The HTML name for form submission

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when the value changes and field loses focus

events.name: focus
events.description: Fired when the field receives focus

events.name: blur
events.description: Fired when the field loses focus

slots.name: leading-icon
slots.description: Icon displayed at the start of the field

slots.name: trailing-icon
slots.description: Icon displayed at the end of the field

keyboardSupport.action: Move focus into/out of the field

accessibility.screenReaderNotes: Announce label, current value, error state, and supporting text. For external labels, use aria-label.
accessibility.focusManagement: Receives focus in tab order. Floating label moves up when focused or has value.

llm.intent: Capture user text input for forms and data entry
antiPatterns: Text field without label or aria-label
Using placeholder as the only label
llm.semanticMeaning: Input field for user-entered text data
